V14 WORKFLOW INSTALL FIX

GitHub's normal full-project browser upload did not carry the hidden .github/workflows folder.
The workflow YAML files themselves are present and valid in V14.

ONE-TIME INSTALL:
1. Open your GitHub repository.
2. Go to .github -> workflows.
3. Click Add file -> Upload files.
4. Extract this ZIP on your computer.
5. Drag ALL FIVE .yml files from this ZIP directly onto the GitHub upload page.
6. Commit changes to main.
7. Go to Actions.

You should then see:
- Hourly Signal Recorder
- 15-Minute Market Observer
- Initialize V10 AI Fund
- 5-Minute Microstructure Observer
- Nightly Deep Learning Review

Do not upload the .txt instruction file into .github/workflows.
